observationsNote: No dated individual trip report was found in public agency sources. Every observation below is one cell of an agency-hosted paddle-guide travel-time table (AZ State Parks Verde River Paddle Maps 2 and 3), so tripDate, flowCfs and flowObservedAt are null; elapsedMinutes is the midpoint of the guide's range and the original wording is quoted in notes. Paddle Map 2 bands: Low 100-500 cfs, Med 500-3000 cfs, High 3000-8000 cfs (the guide points to USGS 'Verde River Near Camp Verde' and 'Verde R Blw Tangle Creek'). Paddle Map 3 Low/Med bands are not defined in cfs (it names USGS 09504000 and 09506000). Cells given in days are kept for completeness with elapsedMinutes null (overnight trips, not usable for drift speed).

derivation.verde-river-camp-verde: refSpeedMph 2.9 = 9 guide miles (Paddle Map 2: 6 + 3) / 3.08 h, the midpoint of the Med-band total 2.5-3.67 h (2 or 3 Hours + 30 or 40 Minutes); refFlowCfs = USGS 09506000 newest value (inside the 500-3000 cfs Med band).
derivation.verde-river-scenic: refSpeedMph 2.6 = 17 mi / 6.5 h (Paddle Map 2 Med band 6 or 7 Hours); refFlowCfs = USGS 09506000 newest value (inside the Med band).
